sections.title: 1. What this doc is and how it was built
bullets: Third of 6 case-study docs (3a–3f). Same format as 3a/3b v1.
Topic 2.1 has 11 case-study slots from the syllabus content points; the flood-strategy slot has a succeeded and a failed case, so 12 cases. 13 pages.
Physical topic: most slots are Factors (climate processes) and Variations (water balance, storage, pathways); the flood slots add Impacts and Strategies.
Built straight to v1 as part of 'do the rest'. Built with tools/build_case_studies.py from tools/data/case_studies_3c.json; charts 2_1_*.png; checked with tools/check_docx.py.

sections.title: 2. Assumptions
bullets: Slot 1 (climate zones) compares long-term averages for three stations rather than a single post-2015 event, because the syllabus point is about average patterns.
Process explanations (e.g. cyclones need warm sea above about 26.5°C, low wind shear) are standard syllabus knowledge, not taken from the listed sources.
Same limits as 3a/3b: no photos (blocked), and figures come from search results quoting each source.

rows: Climate zones
Singapore 2,166 mm is a 1981–2010 average (World Bank); Niamey and Riyadh come from travel and encyclopedia tables, so ranges are shown.
India 2023
'About 36% below normal' is worked out from the reported 162.7 mm vs 254.9 mm.
Freddy
Whether it beat the 31-day record (WMO panel) and the ACE 86 estimate were not final in the sources found.
Rio Negro
12.70 m (Oct 2023) was the record low then; later readings were lower (12.11 m).
Chennai
'300+ water bodies lost' and '140,000 illegal structures' are from secondary reports; deaths 289 (CAG) vs 500+ (Down To Earth).
Pakistan
Damage about US$40 bn (Wikipedia); other estimates are about US$30 bn. Deaths by group are NDMA figures from early September.
SMART Tunnel
Mode 4 count differs (8th vs 9th activation); the 'flooded suburbs' point (Taman Sri Muda) is from general reporting, not the listed sources.
Slot 2 (Hadley/ITCZ)
2020 Sahel floods. Alternative: Hadley cell expansion and Cape Town's drought (3a slot 2).
Slot 11 succeeded
KL's SMART Tunnel. Alternative: an early-warning system (soft strategy).
